intro.title: Permutations
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a function that generates all possible permutations of a given array of numbers. You will learn the core programming concept of backtracking, which explores all potential arrangements by building solutions incrementally and undoing choices when needed. The main technologies involved are JavaScript arrays, recursion, and conditional logic. By the end, you will understand how to systematically generate permutations and implement this algorithm from scratch.
intro.usecase: Permutations are essential for generating all possible arrangements of items, which appears in many real-world software features. E-commerce sites use permutations to display different sorting options for product listings (price low-high, newest first, best rated). Travel booking platforms generate all possible flight or hotel combinations when users filter by multiple criteria. In content management systems, permutations help create all possible URL slug variations or tag combinations for SEO optimization. Developers implement permutation algorithms to build recommendation engines that suggest different product bundles or playlist orders based on user preferences.
